allowed.name: Button
allowed.notes: Use the kind prop (primary/secondary/tertiary/danger/ghost) instead of custom button styles.

allowed.name: Tile
allowed.notes: Also ClickableTile / ExpandableTile for interactive variants.

allowed.name: TextInput
allowed.notes: Use instead of a raw <input>.

allowed.name: TextArea
allowed.notes: Use instead of a raw <textarea>.

allowed.name: Select
allowed.notes: Use instead of a raw <select>.

allowed.name: Dropdown
allowed.notes: Use for single-select menus over a raw <select> when Carbon's styled list behavior is wanted.

allowed.name: DataTable
allowed.notes: Use for tabular data instead of a hand-rolled <table>.

allowed.name: Tabs
allowed.notes: Use with TabList, Tab, TabPanels and TabPanel.

allowed.name: InlineNotification
allowed.notes: Use for inline status/error messaging instead of custom banners.

allowed.name: ProgressIndicator
allowed.notes: Wizard stepper (Basics, Test plan, Participants). Use with ProgressStep.

allowed.name: ProgressStep
allowed.notes: A step inside ProgressIndicator.

allowed.name: ProgressBar
allowed.notes: Criteria progress on a story card and detail panel. Pass value and max; never draw a bar from a styled div.

allowed.name: FileUploader
allowed.notes: Transcript upload (.vtt, .txt, .sbv, .srt). Use FileUploaderDropContainer for the drop zone.

allowed.name: FileUploaderDropContainer
allowed.notes: Drag-and-drop target inside FileUploader.

allowed.name: DatePicker
allowed.notes: Session date. Use with DatePickerInput.

allowed.name: DatePickerInput
allowed.notes: Input inside DatePicker; replaces a raw date input.

allowed.name: OverflowMenu
allowed.notes: Per-card menus (change colour, remove). Use OverflowMenuItem for entries; use isDelete for destructive items.

allowed.name: OverflowMenuItem
allowed.notes: An entry in OverflowMenu.

allowed.name: SideNav
allowed.notes: Project step menu and the left rail. Use SideNavItems and SideNavLink; mark the current step with isActive.

allowed.name: SideNavItems
allowed.notes: Container for SideNavLink entries.

allowed.name: SideNavLink
allowed.notes: A navigation entry; pass isActive, and aria-disabled for locked steps.

allowed.name: ClickableTile
allowed.notes: A whole card that is one action (project cards, story cards). Use instead of a div with onClick, which keyboard users cannot reach.

allowed.name: Search
allowed.notes: Story and project search fields; replaces a raw search input.

allowed.name: ContentSwitcher
allowed.notes: Small mutually exclusive view toggles, for example the Insights tabs when Tabs is too heavy.

allowed.name: SkeletonText
allowed.notes: Placeholder lines while text loads. Prefer it to a spinner when the layout is known.

allowed.name: SkeletonPlaceholder
allowed.notes: Placeholder block for an image or card while it loads.

allowed.name: TabList
allowed.notes: Holds the Tab buttons: <Tabs><TabList aria-label="..."><Tab>One</Tab></TabList><TabPanels><TabPanel>...</TabPanel></TabPanels></Tabs>. Use for views of the same content; use SideNav or routes for different pages.

allowed.name: Table
allowed.notes: The table itself, inside TableContainer. Use for tabular data; never a raw <table>. DataTable supplies sorting, selection and expansion state.

allowed.name: TableContainer
allowed.notes: Gives the table a title, description and toolbar slot.

allowed.name: TableHeader
allowed.notes: A column header; pass isSortable and onClick for sorting.

allowed.name: TableToolbar
allowed.notes: Search and actions above a table.

allowed.name: Switch
allowed.notes: The options inside ContentSwitcher.
